Tiers are by model scale and architecture; see the correction below.
before (see results/history/HISTORY.md), so this board is a re-measurement of

TIERS CORRECTED 2026-08-11 (see results/local_tiers_20260811/tiers.json).
Tier is model scale and architecture only:
HIGH  >100B: ds4 (284B/13B-active). The only model in its class on this fleet.
MID   24-35B: qwen3.6-35b-a3b, ornith-1.0-35b, qwen3.6-27b, glm-4.7-flash,
devstral-small-2.
LOW   <=9B: qwen3.5-9b, ornith-1.0-9b, granite-4.1-8b, prism-coder-7b,
gemma-4-e4b, granite-4-h-tiny.
The id PREFIXES are the as-run labels and are frozen so results stay traceable
to the config that produced them. 'high-ornith-35b' is therefore misnamed: it
is a 35B MoE of the same architecture (qwen3_5_moe) and size as
mid-qwen36-35b-a3b, and was originally placed high because it has a dedicated
claw deployment -- a fact about the fleet, not the model. Trust _tier and
tiers.json over the prefix.
ROUTING. Everything goes through T'Ra except ds4, which is not a registered
T'Ra target and has no registration API (only GET /api/targets). T'Ra
currently has zero healthy claw1/claw2 targets, so a direct hit on the
dedicated vLLM at claw1:8900 contends with nothing scheduled. This mirrors the
2026-08-10 frontier run, which used the same direct config.
T'Ra's llm_generate payload forwards only model/preferred_targets/prompt/
temperature/max_tokens. It does NOT forward stop or top_p, so those fields are
declarative here -- correct if the queue ever gains them, inert today. Two
consequences: the harness's __AETHER_BENCH_END__ stop never reaches a T'Ra
model (so the reasoning-phase stop-token bug cannot fire on these lanes), and
max_output_tokens is the ONLY runaway bound available.
ORNITH TARGET MOVED. destinations.tra.json still points ornith at
claw1_ornith, which is unhealthy -- claw1 now serves ds4. Ornith runs on
claw3 (claw3_ornith, verified active). Entry below targets claw3.
PER-MODEL VALUES that are measured, not guessed:
glm-4.7-flash  max_output_tokens=4096 is a RUNAWAY BOUND. It prints the
program, then the end marker, then recites the guide until something cuts
it off (measured: marker at char 347 of 41,990). 4096 is ~8x the longest
real answer and bounds a runaway to ~3 min. temperature=1.0 is the card
default; low temperature worsens its recursive reasoning.
ds4  temperature=1.0/top_p=0.95 are the model card's, deliberately not the
board's 0.2: at 0.2 it fell into repetition loops that cost 14/146 cases on
2026-08-07. stop=null is required (it names the marker while thinking).
max_output_tokens=65536 is headroom; healthy runs land at ~1300-1900.
everything else  temperature=0.2 / max_output_tokens=24000, the standing
destinations.tra.json precedent. Generous on purpose: reasoning models
return EMPTY content when the output budget is tight.
UNMEASURED RUNAWAY RISK. Only glm has a measured bound. Any other model that
recites after answering will burn 24000 tokens per task. The smoke test is
what surfaces that -- watch per-task wall time before trusting the long run.
